verdict.rationale: Kong's docs say AI Gateway calculates a provider-matching cost for every request and logs it alongside model details and token usage. It aggregates usage analytics across providers in a standardized format, which can be analyzed in Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool. The docs also cite tracking costs across teams, per-consumer spend limits and chargeback. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of spend breakdowns by API key and by individual user, a documented unified cost dashboard view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
